name: Old Jewish Mellah

overview.title: A quarter of memory
overview.p1: El Jadida’s Mellah is the historic Jewish quarter woven into the wider old town. Lanes are quieter than the main souk arteries; the interest is atmosphere and urban history more than monuments.
overview.p2: Walk respectfully, keep photography discreet around homes, and use the Mellah as part of a broader medina loop rather than a long standalone stop.
overview.p3: Pair it with the Portuguese walls and the fishing port for a full reading of the town’s communities and trades.

q1.question: Is there a ticket?
q1.answer: No. It is a living neighbourhood of streets to walk.

q2.question: Guided tours?
q2.answer: Local guides can add context if you want names and stories.

q3.question: How long?
q3.answer: About an hour within a wider medina walk.

q4.question: Safe?
q4.answer: Daytime is usual; stick to busier connecting lanes if unsure.

q5.question: Combine with souks?
q5.answer: Yes — the Mellah and market streets sit in the same old-town fabric.
